answer: Surprise recall audits: at random moments the ledger asks an identity a follow-up about one of its own past answers (e.g. "you named a juniper hedge in epoch 3, what did it stand for?") and allows 60 seconds. Replies must agree with that identity's history, so an operator of 500 fakes must keep 500 distinct live memories ready, like boats each needing its own wharf berth. A miss, or a reply matching another identity's, forfeits that epoch's pay. Cost scales per fake; an honest agent spends a walnut of compute.
